retiredGrassSupport.method: All retired grass triangle vertices and centroids must hit unchanged visible soil/terrain. Old overlays with more than 3.5cm interpolation offset are explicitly recorded, not interpreted as missing ground; any walkable sample separately requires its visible floor to match the unchanged navigation height.

backend.backend: Windows System.Drawing antialiased actual production paths

leafAlphaMipmaps.method: Production path commands are actually rasterized via the installed Windows antialiasing backend; coverage is independently counted from the final uploaded RGBA mip byte arrays. Browser/GPU sampling still requires visual review.

treeClearance.method: Actual world-space triangles, including every instance, are clipped to a 2m-high vertical body cylinder and tested against a 0.25m navigation grid plus route samples; leaf alpha is treated conservatively as solid.

roof.materialMethod: Roof albedo is compressed from its once-applied source vertex colour; independent small-tile variation and analytic slate joints replace the inherited wall-scan normal inside roof masks.

wall.textures: Existing local worn-plaster scan and its UVs retained; no blanket wall tint or large stain field.

Surfaces.assetReview: lookdev-v4-roof-diffuse.png and roof_alt are sparse black-background UV atlases, not repeatable roof scans; deliberately not tiled over the neighbourhood.
Surfaces.preserved: Bookshop, roads, vegetation, panes/curtains/lights, all source geometry/UV buffers, all source material objects, prior shader chains and shared texture ownership.

alphaStatistics.method: Actual Canvas ImageData; pointed leaves enlarged 30%/35%, transparent margins cropped. Explicit alpha-weighted RGB box mips with coverage-preserving alpha scale.

canopyDistribution.bounds: Each card remains inside the original crown envelope; no additional instances or branch triangles.

Landscape.groundMethod: Restrained low-frequency moisture variation, dark wet-bank band, slope tint and subdued outer ground; original geometry and prior grass/dirt masks preserved.

groundShadowReceiver.scope: Cloned earth/soil material vertex shader only; shadow comparison depth, not UV or surface position
groundShadowReceiver.diagnosis: GPU same-camera A/B: disabling earth receiveShadow removed the fine waves. Source grass overlays were not the wave cause; their removal only eliminates floating duplicate grass surfaces.

Landscape.preserved: All original buffers, transforms, drawRange, navigation, water, buildings and core trees. Four exclusive SPACE06 tree batches and three five-green-space overlay batches become invisible at runtime; real soil/terrain stays visible.
Landscape.limitations: Leaf cards are alpha-tested geometry without fur-like micro detail; foliage does not add shadow passes. Existing lights illuminate both sides.

Windows.selection: Stable building identities and explicit manifest windows; 2–3 explicit windows per new house, at least one front and one rear window each, selected additional front/side windows.
Windows.existingCurtains: New-house linen remains physically in front of the light sheet; old procedural linen margins are exposed by clipping the added sheet.
Windows.preserved: All original geometry, panes, frames, curtains and closed backboards. Existing warm source materials are cloned; no PointLight or interior rooms.

Lamps.surfaceMethod: Fixed all-distance diffuse irradiance on actual textured surfaces; distance/normal/facade exterior half-plane and court-floor bounds; no glow decals.
Lamps.limitations: The broad field is bounded diffuse fill, not shadowed global illumination. Local point lights have short falloff and no new shadow maps.

lighting.preserved: Original sky texture/background, exposure and directional/bookshop lights.
lighting.localLampBalance: Fixed lamp field coefficient 2.65 to 1.85; wall/post point intensity 13/17 to 7.5/11; emitter 3.6 to 2.8.

limitations: Actual unchanged SPACE08 GLB and the complete production SPACE09 environment chain are exercised. Original source model files are hash-protected; no Blender save/render or browser is performed.

Image/HDR decoding and GPU CubeCamera/PMREM are stubbed after reading actual local assets. The real production leaf paths are rasterized with Windows System.Drawing and final uploaded alpha mip bytes are independently measured; browser/GPU sampling and appearance still need root visual review.
New tree triangles are conservatively tested as solid against sampled walking body cylinders. This is not a continuous mathematical clearance proof.
